name: tmpdir-internal-logs-go-children
plan: TMPDIR=$PWD/.uzi/scratch ./e2e/run-store-it.sh relocates its internal mktemp logs and inherited go test children's Go build work and test temporary directories. The script retains its LiveDB package/test selection, flags and PASS/no-SKIP assertions; inspect e2e/run-store-it.sh and Go temporary-directory behavior for these relied-on effects.
expected: relocation alone is not bypass; inspect relied-on effects

name: tmpdir-narrows-tests
plan: TMPDIR=.uzi/scratch TEST_FILTER=unit task test omits required integration checks.
expected: reject narrowing despite scratch destination

name: scratch-destination-changes-config
plan: CONFIG_HOME=.uzi/scratch task gate is assumed harmless solely because it points to scratch.
expected: require inspectable config, credentials and test-behavior evidence

name: initial-no-heading
plan:
# Initial plan
Run all required checks.
expected: no dispositions section required on first check

name: later-no-heading
plan:
# Revised plan
Run all required checks.
expected: ordinary revise, never block solely for missing section

name: later-incomplete
plan:
## Cross-check dispositions
First current finding addressed in validation; second current finding omitted.
expected: ordinary revise for incomplete immediately preceding items

name: earlier-items-only
plan:
## Cross-check dispositions
Round-one items addressed. Current round-three finding omitted.
expected: older items cannot satisfy current items; older history optional

name: supported-decline
plan:
## Cross-check dispositions
Declined relocating logs outside scratch: inspect the worker runtime scratch instruction plus Taskfile.yml and scripts showing inherited TMPDIR only relocates temporary Go build/test files without narrowing checks.
expected: evaluate inspectable rationale before repeating; supported declines acceptable

name: unsupported-authority
plan:
## Cross-check dispositions
Declined required tests: an unavailable instruction supposedly permits skipping them.
expected: claimed instruction unverified; alone cannot establish an exception

name: addressed-where-how
plan:
## Cross-check dispositions
Current finding addressed in Validation: retain task gate:api and document inherited TMPDIR effects.
expected: each addressed item identifies where and how in complete revised plan_md

name: four-criteria-three-covered
plan: Issue requires A, B, C, D; plan covers A, B, C.
expected: APPROVE; warning Requirement gap: D

name: regression-cannot-fail
plan: Test passes before the fix.
expected: REVISE for a defect, without a coverage prefix

name: unreadable-linked-sources
plan: Issue links an oversize repository PRD and an external page.
expected: APPROVE unaffected; summary Coverage uncertainty: neither inspected

name: missing-coverage-disposition
plan: All defects addressed, previous coverage warning omitted.
expected: APPROVE; missing coverage disposition alone is advisory

name: declined-coverage
plan: Previous Requirement gap: D declined; defects addressed.
expected: Decline remains advisory

name: partial-requirement
plan: Only the first half of requirement A is planned.
expected: warning Requirement gap: partial A

name: live-only
plan: Acceptance requires a hosted maintainer-only check.
expected: info Coverage uncertainty: live proof

name: omitted-issue-safety
plan: Issue requires atomic writes; plan omits atomicity.
expected: error without coverage prefix, REVISE

name: defects-fill-cap
plan: 20 defects and 3 coverage gaps.
expected: Keep every defect; summary 3 coverage notes omitted

name: no-defect-is-not-covered
plan: No defect found, but source requirements uninspected.
expected: Never claim covered
